suite: Embedding managed/native, tokenizer, HTTP, hosting, and managed quantized kernels
notes: Model tests explicitly exercise CPU pure C# and GGML_CPU native implementations.
Includes independent analytic F32 fixture for mean, CLS and last pooling; full published-model managed/native agreement; strict batch parity; in-flight managed cancellation recovery.
Raw TRX is a local ignored artifact.
ARM packed Q8 tests include row and column tails, zero blocks, ties-even activation rounding, threads 1/3, output canaries, and agreement with existing direct Q8 kernels.

Includes all shared-pool regressions and13 owned-pool thread count, nesting, disposal/join, cancellation identity and recovery cases. Managed encoder uses only owned workers for all formats and math stages.
Three independent scalar full-encoder F32 oracles verify four-head tiled attention on sequence lengths1/3/5/7 and all pooling modes to absolute2e-6.

Six FMA Dot4 and five transposed-key score tests compare with double references, with unaligned starts/tails, NaN padding and output canaries. Key stride has width-1 extra positions beyond total tokens; mixed-sequence total8/start3 regression covered.
Five packed-value oracle cases cover1/3/5/17/129-token tails,1/2/3/4-query tails, unaligned starts and canary output gaps. Q8 one-row remainder reuses existing direct-reference rows1/5 tests.
